From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Subject: Keystone enterprise workshop — draft dayflow & travel constraints

Hi all,

Attached is a first-pass dayflow and a very rough pre-read deck for the Aug 17 on-site at Keystone HQ (files: keystone_dayflow_v1.pdf, pre-read-deck-draft.pptx). High-level asks and constraints below — please read and respond with confirmations by Wed EOD so we can lock logistics with the client.

Summary of what's attached:
- Dayflow (v1): arrival windows, room blocks, AV needs, 5-minute buffer windows between sessions.
- Pre-read (v0.1): objectives, 3 cross-functional prompts for breakout, sample metrics slide.

Requests from our side:
1) Presenter confirmations + final bios (we need them for badges and the session slides)
   - Proposed presenters: Redwood intro (30m) — Mina to lead; Roadmap & ops patterns (45m) — Karthik to lead; Workshop breakout facilitation (3x facilitators) — TBD
2) Travel/arrival constraints: client asked for one coordinated pickup from SFO to campus. We need attendee arrival windows to recommend pickup times.
3) Pre-read feedback: please add comments directly in the Drive link (below) — I'm especially looking for gaps in the breakout prompts.
4) AV / room setup: keynote mic + 2 lavs + HDMI loop + confidence monitor for the stage. Confirm if anyone needs special laptop adapters.

Open questions for Keystone (Emily/Procurement):
- Confirm arrival window preference (single shuttle at 08:15 vs staggered arrivals)
- Any dietary restrictions for the onsite lunch?
- Will the client provide a local AV tech or do we need to bring an engineer?

Next steps: if internal confirmations come back by Wed EOD we can finalize the pick-up and order name badges by Fri.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Program Lead, Customer Workshops
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: keystone_dayflow_v1.pdf (10 pages), pre-read-deck-draft.pptx (18 slides)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/keystone-dayflow-v1

Mina — thanks for the draft, looks good. Quick notes inline and actions below.

Inline:
> Proposed presenters: Redwood intro (30m) — Mina to lead; Roadmap & ops patterns (45m) — Karthik to lead; Workshop breakout facilitation (3x facilitators) — TBD

I can take the roadmap + ops patterns. Suggest we split the 45m into: 20m talk + 25m customer workshop prompt + 10m quick Q&A (so total 55, but we can tighten). For breakout facilitators, I recommend pulling Lauren, Aditya, and one of our CS leads (I'll ping Hannah privately).

AV: confirm we bring the confidence monitor; I'll add an adapter kit (miniDP->HDMI, USB-C) to the kit list.

Travel: single shuttle makes sense. If Keystone prefers a single shuttle, we should aim for pickup 08:00 to land by 09:00 given traffic. If they prefer staggered arrivals, propose 07:45 / 08:30 windows.

Pre-read: I've made comments on slide 3 and 7 (Drive link). I also attached a short presenter brief for the roadmap talk (roadmap_presenter_brief.docx) — please link that into the master folder.

Action items (internal):
- Lauren: can you confirm run-of-show print count and name badge template?
- Aditya: can you take van/driver booking once we get pickup window from Emily?
- Mina: once bios are in, I'll align slide masters and timing.

Thanks —
Karthik
Sr. Product Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: roadmap_presenter_brief.docx

Thanks for the draft, Mina — this is helpful. A few items from Keystone:

1) Pickup window: we prefer a single shuttle. Travelers will mostly be arriving on the 08:00–08:45 flights; can you plan pickup at 08:15? That should cover most attendees.
2) Presenters: Dr. Aaron Pierce will give a 10–15 minute context-setting intro after your opening (aimed at execs). He prefers an afternoon slot if possible (post-lunch) because of clinic duties, but can be flexible.
3) Dietary: two vegetarians and one gluten-free in the group we listed — labels appreciated.
4) AV tech: Keystone will provide an on-site AV tech, but if you want to bring one for stage setup that’s fine — please coordinate directly with our facilities (cc'd).
5) Procurement: DocuSign link for the SOW is below; procurement requests the final attendee list and the scope-of-work summary by Fri EOD to process on their side.

Attachments: Dr. Pierce's bio (aaron_bio.pdf) attached.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/link/SOW-Keystone-2026

Best,
Emily Carter
Program Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Keystone Health
